effect_description_eng:
[Start of Your Main Phase] If your opponent has a Digimon, gain 1 memory.
[End of Your Turn] By suspending this Tamer, 1 of your Digimon gets ＜Piercing＞ (When this Digimon attacks and deletes an opponent's Digimon and survives the battle, it performs any security checks it normally would.) and ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.) until the end of your opponent's turn. If that Digimon has the [Vortex Warriors] trait, unsuspend that Digimon.
